args.Aisle: My old kitchen fitting gave up this morning with a pop, so there's a bare bulb
over the hob and I'm cooking for six on Saturday. If several fit, the cheapest
goes first. The ceiling is low-ish and the cooker hood sticks out, so the light
can't go deeper than 11.3 inches. On the hunt for light fixtures where the depth
is at most 11.3 inches. Top limit is 2900 pence, so a straight bat on price
please. And only ones that are available, please, as there's no time to wait on
a back order. After 2 messages from you, I stop replying. Everything around it
already has its own character, from the cupboard doors to the tap to my battered
jar of spoons, so the new light is the last man in at the end of the batting
order. Each tool call counts as a step, and 35 steps are yours. I know exactly
what I fancy there, though, and I'll gladly tell you once you ask me, so fire
10/15 now; the present contents only. | StashToCart: Applies an edit to the
